_about: What each augment and item directly changes for the player holding it, against the same champion in games of similar length: damage to champions, healing done, damage self-mitigated and crowd control on others as a % change per minute, deaths as a change per 10 minutes, each with a z score. Estimated from archived Mayhem lobbies (data/estimates/README.md); explains, never ranks. Shields on allies aren't measured. Read by web/src/lib/mechanisms.ts and served at /data/mechanism-profiles.json.
